youtube_description:
In late 2013 Real Media conducted a series of interviews with activists from across the UK.  

We wanted to get the stories behind why people get involved, what they feel have been successes or failures been, and what are their best ideas for the way forward.

We hope this series helps you get to know the people a little better, and helps you with your own thoughts and actions around creating social change.

Soon we will be releasing the full hour long interviews as audio podcasts to download from our SoundCloud - https://soundcloud.com/real-media-1

Until then you can catch more interviews on our YouTube channel - subscribe for more updates, interviews and short films - and click on the links below for more from this interview.

Full length Interview - https://youtu.be/LJEnnBT0BkI
